# XiriaCanvas AI 1.3.0

A workflow release. XirAI gains a server-side **XYZ comparison** mode, a **LoRA mix search** built on it, a new **图片反推** (image tagging) page with four local taggers, **LoRA location repair** for libraries whose files moved, and **gallery import / export**. Starting XirAI no longer kills running services, and a damaged settings file can no longer be mistaken for an empty one. Ordinary text-to-image and image-to-image retain the existing inference protocol.

**Upgrading from 1.2.2:** update in place (Settings → About). No new Node or Python packages, no settings migration, and the inference protocol stays **39**. The tagger runtime (ONNX Runtime) and tagger models are installed on demand from the 图片反推 page. After updating, restart XirAI and refresh any open browser tab.

## 本版要点

- **XYZ 对比生成**：生成模式新增“XYZ 对比生成”。每个引擎有独立的 XYZ 草稿，X / Y / Z 三轴互独立选择，可选步数、CFG、采样器、调度器、种子、提示词、精确替换、模型组件以及 LoRA 实例权重，数值轴支持自定义或阶梯取值；服务端预检后在后台执行，关闭浏览器不会中断。结果网格支持放大查看、加入画廊、应用到基础生图，并可导出整张网格 PNG（附 JSON 清单）。旧草稿里已保存的 LoRA 模型 / 方案 / 倍率轴仍按原定义原样保留，只是不能再用作新轴；配比搜索仍在独立的 LoRA 混合搜索模块中提供。
- **LoRA 混合搜索**：在 XYZ 之上按规则（位移、预算、样本数）自动生成多组 LoRA 权重配比，多轮搜索不会重复已测过的配比；结果以候选网格展示，可收藏、追加下一轮、保存为新组合，并导出候选网格 PNG（可选标注每格的 LoRA 权重）。
- **网格 PNG 摘要显示 LoRA 名称**：X / Y / Z 任一轴为 LoRA 时，摘要写出具体的 LoRA 名称，而不是 `lora_weight` 这样的字段名。
- **图片反推**：新的顶层页面，支持 WD14、CL Tagger、Camie Tagger v2、PixAI Tagger 四个本地反推引擎；拖入或粘贴图片自动反推，结果可编辑、复制、导出 TXT，也可对文件夹批量处理。模型按需下载并校验。
- **LoRA 位置修复**：LoRA 文件被移动或改名后，在 LoRA 管理里扫描并匹配新位置，确认后一次性改写挂载、组合与画廊卡片里的引用；不搬动、不复制权重，支持撤销。
- **画廊导入 / 导出**：多选收藏夹导出到 output 下的新文件夹（可同时下载 ZIP，内含 `gallery-info.json`）；导入时填写 ZIP 路径或拖入 ZIP，图片写入 output 下的指定文件夹并新建收藏夹，同名时自动另建，不会覆盖。
- **任务管理**：XYZ 与 LoRA 混合搜索的结果页可以多选或全部删除当前模块的非活动任务。删除是持久化的逻辑隐藏，不物理擦除任务存档；原图、网格图和画廊内容都保留，活动任务不能删除，混合搜索会一起隐藏整个会话的所有轮次。
- **启动更安全**：Start 不再无条件结束已在运行的进程，能复用健康的服务；Windows 用系统默认浏览器打开主页。界面设置文件读取失败时会提示重试，而不是当作空白设置覆盖保存。
- **基础生图与图生图**：保留原有生成入口与设置；推理协议仍为 39。

## Highlights

- **XYZ comparison.** A new generation mode runs whole parameter grids in the service: up to three typed axes plus repeat samples, server preflight, background execution that survives closing the browser, batched cells where only the seed differs, and a single-PNG export of the whole grid with a JSON manifest.
- **LoRA mix search.** Rule-driven LoRA weight mixes on top of XYZ, with rounds that never retest a tested mix, a candidate grid, follow-up rounds, saving a mix as a new LoRA group, and a candidate-grid export that can list each image's LoRA weights.
- **Image tagging.** A 图片反推 page with WD14, CL Tagger, Camie Tagger v2 and PixAI Tagger running locally, single-image auto tagging, an editable history and folder batches.
- **LoRA location repair.** Re-link moved or renamed LoRA files across mounts, groups and gallery cards in one confirmed, undoable operation.
- **Gallery import / export** through a ZIP that carries `gallery-info.json`.
- **Safer start-up and settings.** No more blanket process cleanup on Start; unreadable settings are reported, not overwritten.

## XYZ comparison

- **Drafts.** Each engine keeps its own XYZ draft; switching modes never unloads a model, edits the LoRA mounts or cancels a job. 从基础生图同步基线 copies selected fields (models, composed prompt, sampling, canvas, LoRA mounts) into the draft; nothing is written back to Basic.
- **Axes.** Steps, CFG or distilled guidance, sampler, scheduler, seed, guidance and PAG scale, CLIP skip, checkpoint or model components, positive and negative prompts, exact find/replace, and LoRA instance weight — only what the engine supports is offered, and X, Y and Z are chosen independently. Numeric axes take custom lists or exact staircases (steps `12..20 / 2` gives five values). Seeds stay exact unsigned 64-bit values; a sample shares one seed across all combinations. Saved drafts that still carry a retired LoRA model, profile or multiplier axis keep their original definition and values, but a new axis cannot select them; mix search stays in the separate LoRA mix search module.
- **Canvas.** The original generation size is fixed for every cell when the experiment is submitted; axes cannot change it. Inheriting the post-processing chain is off by default.
- **Execution.** Experiments persist in the service and run one cell at a time by default. Concurrency 2–10 merges only cells that differ in nothing but the seed into one real batch, and the actual concurrency is reported. A failing cell pauses the experiment for retry, skip or stop; after a restart, unfinished cells continue only when you choose to.
- **Results.** Paged by Z and sample, with a screen cell size independent of the generation size. Each cell opens in the viewer, can be added to the gallery or applied to Basic with its frozen settings, and its PNG carries the cell identity.
- **Grid export.** A single PNG of the whole experiment or the current page, at original resolution or scaled down once in linear light, in a light or dark report theme, with a JSON manifest beside it. It runs on the CPU outside the generation queue. Chinese text uses the bundled Noto Sans SC font (SIL OFL 1.1, licence included). A LoRA axis is now summarised by the LoRA's name (`X：LoRA 权重 · <name>`).

## LoRA mix search

- Choose the LoRAs to test, set exact rules (fixed members, displacement, budget, samples, sampling seed), preview the reproducible candidate list and confirm; each round is one XYZ experiment.
- Tested and reserved mixes are remembered per context, so later rounds draw only new mixes; remaining candidates can be listed or downloaded as CSV / JSON.
- The candidate grid supports favourites, details, follow-up rounds (adjust and continue), saving a full mix (global plus tested LoRAs) as a new LoRA group, viewer / gallery / apply actions, and a candidate-grid PNG export. The export moves a seed shared by a whole sample into the summary and can optionally number the tested LoRAs and print each image's weights.
- Library LoRA groups can be copied into the XYZ LoRA manager as verified snapshots, with a conflict preview and explicit copy / enable / replace choices.

## Image tagging (图片反推)

- Four local engines: WD14, CL Tagger, Camie Tagger v2 and PixAI Tagger, on CPU or GPU where the runtime allows. The tagger runtime and each model are downloaded on demand and verified against fixed digests; a model whose files fail verification is not used.
- Drop or paste one image to tag it automatically; results show four rating scores and editable tags that can be copied or saved as TXT. Earlier images stay in a thumbnail history and can be re-run with new thresholds.
- Folder batches write a TXT next to each image, skip existing files by default, and accept folders outside `outputs`. Folder batches, model downloads and runtime installs are accepted only from the computer running XirAI.

## LoRA location repair

- Open **LoRA 位置与关联 → 修复 LoRA 位置** in the LoRA manager or on the `/lora` page. Pick the engine, the folder the missing files came from and the folder to match against, then scan.
- Suggestions are ranked by evidence (full-content hash first, then original root, exact name and folder grouping); ties are never pre-filled. Each row can be changed, skipped, or browsed against every available file.
- Confirming re-links mounts, LoRA groups and gallery cards in one operation, optionally recording a historical substitution so old PNGs resolve too. Weights are never moved or copied, shared folders stay read-only, and each operation can be undone. A LoRA you really deleted can be confirmed as deleted and removed from the chosen places.

## Gallery import / export

- **导入 / 导出** in the gallery toolbar opens one window. Export copies the chosen collections, in gallery order, to `outputs/XiriusA-Gallery-<date>-<time>/` — one folder per collection plus `gallery-info.json` — and can start a browser ZIP download of the same package.
- Import takes the path of an exported ZIP (on the computer running XirAI) or a ZIP dropped onto the window, and an optional folder name inside `output` (blank uses the current time). It creates new collections with card order, titles, settings and image names kept; a name already in use becomes `name (2)`. A failed import leaves no folder and no collection behind.

## Start-up, settings and housekeeping

- **Start** no longer kills processes it finds running: it reuses a healthy XirAI service on the same ports and refuses a port held by something else. On Windows the main page opens once in the system default browser.
- **Settings safety.** The workspace loads only from a complete, verified settings file. A read error shows a retry instead of an empty workspace, and a failed save keeps your edits and pauses autosave rather than writing over the file.
- **Task records.** XYZ and LoRA mix search results have a 管理任务 window for selected or all inactive tasks across engines in the current module only. Deletion persistently hides records; it does not physically erase their stored archives. Active tasks cannot be deleted. Images, grid exports and gallery cards are kept; a mix-search session is hidden together with every round.
- Toolbox and model downloader layout tidied; the XYZ-family dialogs use the dark scrollbar of the rest of the interface.
